coverage_note: Wi-Fi drop around 02:31-03:01 (his شوربة line cut; Amal 'No.' at 02:41 was about not hearing). 30:11 mara-maratat -> مطرت treated as a stumble (Amal: tongue twister), not a slip. 36:45 تلجات -> Amal تَلَّجَت treated as vowel length / pronunciation (he said تلجت right at 35:25). 05:34 تلاتة -> تنتين is a fact fix (wrong hour), not language. 06:10 'شوي dangerous': dangerous not on the sheet, skipped. 06:27 بنقلق and 29:41 بمطر were questions, skipped. 1:06:49 عافيا فيكي unclear (Amal answered يعطيك العافية), skipped. Echo: 'Matarat.' (30:17) = مطرت; 'Uh, el warda.' 47:21 = الوردة; 'Ward.' 47:24 = وردات?; 'Zariya.' = زريعة; 'He rasa biwaja.' 04:07 = هي راسها بيوجع. Engine garble in Amal lines: 32:14 زعلتكش عن (likely غير عن), 40:30 عجل/عجا (= his أجا), 43:06 بهدئ (= بحرق), 47:24 وحدات (likely وردات), 16:49 فئة واحدة. Long English meta stretches 56:00-1:02:30 and 1:04:11-end.

rows.why: Fiancée is female so the adjective needs -a; Amal echoed عيانة and again at 02:23 (لسة ... عيانة), he repeated عيانة at 02:26.
Amal recast his order (verb with object ending before the head) into topic + راسها بيوجع, and he repeated her version at 04:07.

rows.medi_said: الـ or لا الـ نار. / لـ النار for fire
rows.amal_said: You're worried from. You're worried about. You're worried from. ... Men، men.
rows.why: قلقان takes من; he tried لـ/لا and Amal told him 'worried from' and gave من (07:27), he then said من نار.
rows.english: We are worried about the fire.

rows.amal_said: no. There's another word for that.
rows.right: (another verb for a fire starting - not given)
rows.why: For 'a fire will start' he offered يبدأ; Amal said no, there is another word, and set it aside.

rows.medi_said: do I know how to say taking care or like caring for? I don't know how to say this right.
rows.why: He asked how to say 'taking care'; Amal supplied ديرت بالي.
Amal named the fixed preposition: بدير بالي takes على; he then said ديرت بالي على خطيبتي.
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée.

rows.amal_said: دير بالك is actually the command form.
rows.why: Wrong possessive ending (باليك for بالك) and a feminine command for a new example; Amal gave the right form دير بالك and noted it is the command.
After خلينا the verb is a bare present; Amal recast نعمل and he repeated خلينا نعمل.

rows.medi_said: الدرس إنه إنتي... / الدرس إنه، uh, إنه تخطط-- تفتتلي.
rows.why: For 'the lesson that you planned' he used إنه as a relative pronoun where اللي is needed; Amal only asked كيف يعني and moved on (my reading).
rows.english: Let's do the lesson that you planned.

rows.medi_said: Uh, عصا- is it، أسف؟ No. That's bird. ... is it عصافير؟ ... أنا نسيته.
rows.why: He could not find 'sky' (tried عصافير = birds, Amal: No, عصافير is birds), said أنا نسيته, and Amal supplied سما. Sheet: sky | Sama | سما.
Amal asked 'one item?' (engine فئة واحدة) and he changed to the plural غيوم, which she accepted.

rows.medi_said: When, when do you look at the sky? When do you watch the sky?
rows.amal_said: No، امتى بتتطلع على الشمس would be when do you watch the sky؟ امتى الشمس بتطلع؟
rows.why: Listening: he misread her امتى الشمس بتطلع as 'when do you watch the sky'; Amal said no and explained بتطلع = go up.

rows.medi_said: does it has to do with Azan? ... بس سجر. سجر؟
rows.amal_said: أذان؟ No. أذان is the call to prayer. فجر.
rows.why: For dawn he offered أذان (call to prayer) then سجر; Amal said no and gave فجر.
Repeating her word 'other than' he said غير لو; Amal said 'No لو. غير' (لو belongs with حتى لو).
He built 'the night sky' as الليل سما (el- on the first noun, bare second); Amal recast السما بالليل and he repeated it.
She asked how to say it's dark at night; he said أنا نسيت and she supplied عتمة.
With one the noun comes first and the number after (شمس وحدة); Amal only echoed واحدة and said great job (my reading, she let the order pass).
Amal echoed his تاني as a prompt and he changed to تانية to agree with feminine نجمة; she said مهم (ok).
Amal named the pointer rule; he said 'I forgot the pointer rule' and gave بشوفها.
rows.english: This is the first star I see today.

rows.medi_said: since is لسـ-- لسا, right? ... Is it لا؟
rows.amal_said: No. Since-- لا is until. ... من.
rows.why: He asked for 'since' (guessed لسا, then لا); Amal said no and supplied من.

rows.medi_said: So the air would be الأول هون. ... الأول هون
rows.why: For 'the air' he said الأول (the first); Amal recast الهوا هون and, when he asked what he said, echoed الأول.

rows.medi_said: آآ، بعيد ... بعيد من cuz it's comparative, right?
rows.why: For 'different' he used بعيد (far); Amal asked 'What's the word?' and he ended with الهواء هون غير عن الهواء هناك (32:47). Sheet: different (from) | mu5talef | مختلف.
rows.english: The air here is different than the air there.

rows.medi_said: بعيد من cuz it's comparative, right?
rows.why: Amal gave عن (engine wrote زعلتكش عن, likely غير عن) as the preposition and confirmed عن at 32:21; he then said غير عن.

rows.amal_said: آخر المرة means the last of the time. The end of the time. ... صح. آخر مرة. The last time.
rows.why: Amal explained آخر + el- = the end of; 'the last time' is آخر مرة, and he repeated it.
Subject مرة is feminine; Amal prompted 'مرة is' and he said feminine. كانت.
rows.english: (The last time it snowed) was three years ago.

rows.why: سنان is teeth; Amal recast سنين, and at 36:25 asked 'What's سنان?' (he: teeth). He repeated سنان at 36:17 - same moment.

rows.amal_said: No. ثلاث سنين الماضيين أو الماضيات would be for the last three years. ... Ago is قبل. So قبل ثلاث سنين.
rows.why: For 'ago' he used الماضي; Amal said no (that means 'the last three years') and gave قبل ثلاث سنين.

rows.amal_said: إيش يعني عجل؟ ... عجا كتير الصباح؟ إيش يعني؟
rows.right: (she redirected: الهوا كان قوي كتير الصباح)
rows.why: For the wind he used أجا (came); Amal twice asked إيش يعني and steered him to كان قوي; engine wrote عجل/عجا for her echo of أجا.
rows.english: The wind was very strong in the morning.

rows.why: 'I cleaned it' needs the object ending; Amal prompted 'It.' and he said نظفتها, which she repeated.
Listing what is on the land he gave singular الوردة; Amal prompted (engine وحدات؟, likely وردات) and he said وردات, she said Mm.

rows.medi_said: Is it the bee? Is it the bee plants?
rows.why: He could not find 'plants' (asked about bee plants / زبيب); Amal supplied زريعة.

rows.medi_said: I don't, أنا بعرف، ما بعرف.
rows.why: Amal asked if he remembered 'stones'; he said ما بعرف and she supplied حجر. Sheet: stone | 7ajar | حجر.
He meant the old streets in general; Amal recast plural الشوارع and he repeated it (also fixes the agreement with قديمة).

rows.amal_said: Or just حجر. Are stone. ... Made of is different than made. ... الشوارع الإدام في أمريكا حجر.
rows.why: 'Made with stone' rendered with مع; Amal said just حجر ('are stone'), made of is different, and recast the whole sentence.
rows.english: The old streets in America are (made of) stone.

rows.amal_said: تاني حجر or الحجر التاني. You said it first right.
rows.why: حجر تاني means 'another stone'; for 'the second stone' Amal gave تاني حجر or الحجر التاني, and he went back to تاني حجر.
rows.english: The second stone was my favorite.

rows.amal_said: So you could either say my favorite stone or my favorite using عندي. المفضل عندي.
rows.why: مفضل is an adjective and never takes a pronoun ending (Amal 54:56 'Never takes pronoun ending'); she gave المفضل عندي.
rows.english: The second stone was my favorite.

rows.medi_said: I was gonna say الـ مفضل حجر.
rows.amal_said: الحجر المفضل or حجري المفضل. المفضل is an adjective.
rows.why: Adjective placed before the noun; Amal gave الحجر المفضل and said المفضل is an adjective (after the noun).
A noun with a possessive ending takes no el-; Amal said 'No ال first' and he said حجري المفضل.

rows.amal_said: But al-mufaddal is an adjective, so it follows ders. ... هاد الدرس المفضل عندي.
rows.why: Amal said المفضل is an adjective following درس and gave هاد الدرس المفضل عندي (el- on the adjective).

rows.amal_said: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون. ... في is not is. في is there is.
rows.why: For 'isn't here' he used في (there is); Amal said not في, مش هون, explaining في = there is. Sheet: here | Hoan | هون.
